title: The Legacy of the Chen Family Ancestors
next_chapter_hook: Mo Xiansheng's form gradually faded in the moonlight, his final words like thunder—Chen Xuan's ruins entrance had appeared, yet at this moment, from the depths of the heavens, a indifferent gaze descended suddenly, the aura of the Heavenly Eye.

text.content: The moonlight like frost illuminated Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul as nearly transparent. He floated in mid-air, surrounded by pale blue Spiritual Light, as if he would be scattered by the night wind at any moment. Chen Ji stood in place, spine straight, his gaze tranquil as still water, waiting for this mysterious remnant soul guardian to unveil the final mystery.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, do you know that the Chen family bloodline flowing in your veins was written into the Heavenly Fate chess game ten thousand years ago? Mo Xiansheng's voice was low and distant, every word seemingly carrying the weight of a thousand jun. However, your ancestor... he was no coward willing to be a chess piece.

text.content: Chen Ji's heart rate suddenly accelerated, his pupils slightly contracted. He watched as Mo Xiansheng slowly raised his hand, a mysterious rune condensing at his fingertip, the rune glowing with dark gold light, and the resonance it produced deep within his bloodline nearly suffocated him—it was the unique mark of the Chen family, a pattern he had seen countless times in the family genealogy since childhood.

dialogue.content: This is the secret words your ancestor left before his death. Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly became somewhat trembling, as if recalling some distant past. 'Sacrifice is not an ending, but the beginning of breaking the局.' Ten thousand years ago he foresaw today's situation, deliberately causing the sacrifice to fail, placing hope in the bloodline of future generations.

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly looked up, his fists unconsciously clenched tight. He thought of his experiences over these years—being regarded as waste, suffering bullying, surviving in the cracks. So all of this was already destined ten thousand years ago? Yet what the ancestor left behind was not a hopeless fate, but a sliver of opportunity to break the局?

dialogue.content: You guessed correctly. Mo Xiansheng's figure slightly swayed, as if maintaining his form was already quite exhausting. Back then, your ancestor Chen Xuan and I, we were both candidate inheritors of the Tianji Record. However, the Heavenly Eye chose your ancestor, yet treated him as a chess piece, intending to completely sever the inheritance of the Tianji Record through bloodline sacrifice.

text.content: The night wind rose abruptly, rustling Chen Ji's garments. He stood quietly under the moonlight, listening to Mo Xiansheng continue recounting the events of ten thousand years ago. Chen Xuan—that was his name, also the original master of the Tianji Record. He discovered the Heavenly Eye's conspiracy, chose to end the sacrifice in failure, sealing the truth within the ruins.

dialogue.content: As for me... Mo Xiansheng gave a bitter smile, I was originally Chen Xuan's comrade-in-arms, responsible for compiling that list. I should have died together with him, yet he used a secret technique to preserve my remnant soul, guarding this place, waiting for the arrival of the Chen family descendant. I waited ten thousand years, and finally waited for you.

text.content: Chen Ji felt a burning sensation in his chest, that was the power surging from deep within his bloodline. He closed his eyes, allowing that power to flow through his body—it was a warm and tragic feeling, as if countless ancestors' wills were whispering in the bloodline, telling a story of defiance and hope.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng... Chen Ji opened his eyes, his voice somewhat hoarse, where is Chen Xuan's ruins? Since my ancestor left the method to break the局, Chen Ji's bloodline should inherit this legacy.

text.content: Under the moonlight, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly bloomed with dazzling light, the first time in ten thousand years he had poured out all his strength. His form became clear, the facial features' contours faintly discernible—it was a face of steadfastness and gentleness, surprisingly similar to Chen Ji, as if crossing through ten thousand years, completing some kind of bloodline handover at this moment.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng was about to speak the location of Chen Xuan's ruins. At this crossroads of destiny, Chen Ji faced a choice—to fully accept the ancestor's arrangement, or to walk his own path?

choices.description: Accept the ancestor's arrangement, inherit Chen Xuan's method to break the局, complete the unfinished rebellion from ten thousand years ago.
choices.visible_cost: May face greater Heavenly Fate backlash
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete method to break the局, receive the ancestor's power blessing
choices.risk_hint: The ancestor's plan may be incomplete, following the old path may lead to repeating past mistakes

text.content: Upon hearing this, a light of mixed relief and worry flashed in Mo Xiansheng's eyes. He reached out, pointing faintly at Chen Ji's Brow Center, a section of dust-sealed memories surging into Chen Ji's mind like a tide—the final scene before Chen Xuan's death.

choices.description: Not be constrained by the ancestor's plan, combine one's own Tianji Record Fragment, create a brand new method to break the局.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the ancestor's direct blessing, need to explore independently
choices.visible_reward: Break free from the existing framework of destiny, possess unlimited possibilities
choices.risk_hint: Independent exploration may waste time, give the Heavenly Eye an opportunity

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng was slightly stunned, then wore a complex expression. Interesting... you are more rebellious than your ancestor. But perhaps this is exactly the variable that Heavenly Secrets didn't anticipate. Very well, I respect your choice.

choices.memory_label: 主角展现出独立的意志

text.content: Chen Ji felt a mighty power surge into his body—that was the final gift left by Chen Xuan. Before his eyes emerged a blurry scene—deep within the endless mountains, an ancient palace shrouded in clouds and mist loomed faintly, and that was where Chen Xuan's ruins lay. Position, entrance, mechanisms... all information was seared into his mind like a brand.

dialogue.content: In the ruins lies the method to sever the sacrificial contract. Yet Mo Xiansheng's tone suddenly turned grave, Chen Ji, remember—time is running out. For ten thousand years, Heavenly Secrets has been hunting these ruins. Now it has locked onto my remnant soul's location and will soon trace its way here.

text.content: Chen Ji felt a solemn yet resolute power surge through his bloodline. His ancestor Chen Xuan had challenged Heaven alone ten thousand years ago, ultimately failing yet planting the seeds of hope. And now, this heavy legacy has been passed into his hands. He gazed at Mo Xiansheng, his eyes holding no hesitation—only the unyielding resolve to break all bridges behind him.

Mo Xiansheng's form began to fade, yet a serene smile spread across his face. Ten thousand years... I have finally fulfilled my promise to Chen Xuan. His voice grew fainter, Chen Ji, you have exceeded my expectations. Whether inheriting this legacy or forging your own path... you are already prepared. Go now, Heavenly Secrets won't give you much time...

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gazed toward where Mo Xiansheng had vanished, slowly kneeling, his forehead touching the ground in a solemn farewell. Ancestor Chen Xuan, Mo Xiansheng... rest assured, this legacy, I Chen Ji shall inherit. His voice was deep and resolute, echoing in the night wind.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji rose, an indifferent gaze descended from the depths of the heavens. That was no cultivator's presence, but a will transcending heaven and earth—Heavenly Secrets. It had sensed Mo Xiansheng's dissipation, and detected the aura of Chen Xuan's ruins. Chen Ji's back was instantly soaked with cold sweat, yet he forced himself to remain composed, turning and racing toward the ruins.

choice.prompt: Heavenly Secrets' gaze drew closer and closer, and Chen Ji had to make a choice—rush at full speed to the ruins to enter before Heavenly Secrets locks on, or set up a deceptive formation to delay the pursuit?

choices.text: Rush to the ruins at full speed
choices.description: Seize every moment, racing to the ruins before Heavenly Secrets to争取 the final opportunity.
choices.visible_cost: Consume massive Spiritual Energy, possibly exhausting yourself at the ruins' entrance.
choices.visible_reward: Enter the ruins first, claiming the ancestor's complete legacy.
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Secrets' speed far exceeds imagination, possibly intercepting you en route.

text.content: Chen Ji's Spiritual Energy churned within him like a boiling sea, furiously surging toward his legs. His form became a blur, carving uncanny arcs through the night. In the distance, the ancient palace shrouded in mist drew ever closer...

choices.text: Set up a deceptive formation to delay
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record's Foresight Ability to arrange a deceptive formation, buying more preparation time for yourself.
choices.visible_cost: Consume Heavenly Fate, exposing the Tianji Record's aura.
choices.visible_reward: Gain ample preparation time, entering the ruins in optimal condition.
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record's aura might attract more pursuers.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji halted his steps, eyes gleaming with intensity. He retrieved the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest, softly reciting the incantation. Mystical runes flew from the fragment, weaving an enormous illusionary formation spanning a hundred li, sufficient to bewilder Heavenly Secrets for a moment.

text.content: The indifferent gaze on the horizon suddenly turned sharp, like an invisible giant eye locking onto this region. Chen Ji felt an ineffable pressure descend from the heavens—that was Heavenly Secrets' might. For ten thousand years it had been waiting for this moment, waiting for the inheritor of the Tianji Record to deliver himself into its trap. Yet a cold smirk tugged at Chen Ji's lips, his stride没有丝毫 hesitation.

Mo Xiansheng's form gradually dimmed in the moonlight, his final words resonating like thunder—Chen Xuan's ruins' entrance had appeared, yet precisely at this instant, an indifferent gaze descended from the heavens' depths, bearing the aura of Heavenly Secrets. It had already sensed Mo Xiansheng's dissipation, and detected the resurgence of Chen Xuan's ruins. A chase spanning ten thousand years officially begins.
